dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-to-posterior dorsal section contains multiple 'C' and irregular 'O' shaped structures. The most prominent displays a sharp, high-frequency transition from a dark exterior to a thin, bright perimeter line. Secondary structures further posterior show more diffuse, low-gradient edges with irregular, non-geometric perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the anterior-lateral flank and ventral-lateral neck region. These clusters are tightly grouped with high core pixel concentration, showing minimal internal gradient and high contrast against the surrounding medium-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the posterior-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary vertex oriented towards the dorsal ridge and the longest axis extending towards the posterior extremity.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, high-intensity patch on the mid-lateral flank exhibits a complex dendritic perimeter where high-intensity pixels interdigitate with the darker dorsal background texture.
